description.value: Frequency once per 10 minutes. Requirements A genuine enemy is within 30 feet and you wield a gunblade. Draw aether from the foe. Increase your maximum cartridges by 3 (normally to 6) for 1 minute or until the encounter ends, whichever comes first, then load 3 cartridges. When this ends, discard cartridges above your normal maximum. You gain Ready to Reign for the same duration; it allows one Reign of Beasts sequence if you have that feat.
